characters.name: Harry Potter
characters.description: The Boy Who Lived, defeater of Voldemort.

characters.description: Tom Riddle, the most dangerous dark wizard of all time.

characters.description: Greatest wizard of his age, Headmaster of Hogwarts.

characters.description: Potions Master, double agent, bravest man Harry knew.

characters.name: Hermione Granger
characters.description: Brightest witch of her age, master of logic and spells.

characters.description: Dark wizard who sought wizard dominance over Muggles.

characters.description: Voldemort's most fanatical and cruel Death Eater.

characters.description: Transfiguration Master, Deputy Headmistress of Hogwarts.

characters.description: Harry's godfather, escaped prisoner of Azkaban.

characters.name: Remus Lupin
characters.description: Werewolf, former Defense Against Dark Arts professor.

characters.name: James Potter
characters.description: Harry's father, talented Animagus and Marauder.

characters.name: Lily Potter
characters.description: Harry's mother, whose sacrifice gave him protection.

characters.name: Molly Weasley
characters.description: Matriarch of the Weasleys, defeated Bellatrix in duel.

characters.name: Arthur Weasley
characters.description: Muggle-enthusiast, father of the Weasley clan.

characters.name: Ron Weasley
characters.description: Harry's loyal best friend, chess master.

characters.name: Ginny Weasley
characters.description: Powerful witch, accomplished Quidditch player.

characters.name: Fred & George Weasley
characters.description: Twin pranksters, founders of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes.

characters.name: Luna Lovegood
characters.description: Dreamy Ravenclaw, believer in the extraordinary.

characters.name: Kingsley Shacklebolt
characters.description: Auror, Order member, future Minister of Magic.

characters.name: Alastor Moody
characters.description: Legendary Auror, 'Constant Vigilance'.

characters.name: Nymphadora Tonks
characters.description: Metamorphmagus Auror, member of the Order.

characters.name: Cedric Diggory
characters.description: Hufflepuff champion, model of fair play.
